title: Not hearing King Oliver; meeting Buddy Petit
summary: Howard did not hear King Oliver or Keppard but met Buddy Petit.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Yeah. You see? Yeah. In regard to some of the early, Thomas, do you remember King Oliver, or Joe Oliver as they call him? No. Did you ever hear him when you were a kid? No. He left, I guess, when you were ten years old. I imagine.
He should have been. I don't know anything about him.
Do you ever remember hearing Keppert anything?
No. Never heard Keppert. No, I played Buddy Petit. I met him.
Yeah, Buddy Petit. Well, I played his film at Louis Armstrong, we're here at the Suburban Garden, 1930 or 31, between that time.
